label_basis: conc column of author ILSdata.csv. Unit confirmed by supporting information Table S1 (Adenine, microM). Original author values are retained, not replaced by nominal calibration levels.
preprocessing_in_source: Original individually deposited TXT spectra are used, not the shared-grid compiled CSV intensities.
group_definition: labcode + method + sample + batch. Solid substrates have a/b/c position replicates; colloids commonly have one spectrum per batch.
recommended_split: For new samples, block shared_sample_id across batches; for transfer evaluation leave entire laboratories or methods out. Do not randomly split spectra.
limitations: The 1744 source groups do not imply 1744 independently prepared concentrations. The same concentration/sample occurs across batches and laboratories.
Original train/test/blank markers are retained. Their validation role must be respected when reproducing the published evaluation.
Different raw spectra retain different grids and spectral ranges. Alignment must be fitted within future training folds.
Quantitative labels in cAg@785 and sAg@532 conflict with SI Table S1; 1401 spectra are flagged for review. Original labels are retained, not certified.

Four pairs of byte-identical spectra occur in the original records. Two pairs span nominal batch groups (four records); the other two pairs are within a group. Keep every identical pair in one validation fold; original records are preserved.
spectral_processing_by_importer: None. Row sorting only; no interpolation, normalization, baseline correction or smoothing.
intensity_unit: Original arbitrary instrument units; not harmonized across instruments.

label_audit.example_1: Author ILSdata.csv: cAg@785 C1=0.2 uM; SI Table S1: cAg@785 C1=1 uM.
label_audit.example_2: Author ILSdata.csv: sAg@532 C1=1 uM; SI Table S1: sAg@532 C1=0.2 uM.
label_audit.supporting_evidence: SI Table S8 reports concentration ranges consistent with the CSV grouping; this suggests an internal source inconsistency, not a justified automatic relabeling.
label_audit.action: Retain original CSV labels. Exclude flagged methods from quantitative training/evaluation until resolved using an authoritative correction or author clarification. Do not infer the correct source solely from this audit.

modality_details.classification_basis: The study quantifies adenine using its ring-breathing spectral band on metal colloidal/solid substrates.
modality_details.signal_species_relationship: Intrinsic Raman signatures of the analytical targets; reference SMILES do not establish adsorbed-state structures.
modality_details.assignment_scope: Imported measurement branch, including its associated blank controls.
